description: Find the user's stored open jobs closest to a resume, by proximity only: job_ids with their title and a similarity between 0 and 1, best first, and whether the resume is already scored for each. No evaluation: score the ones worth it with score_resumes. Give the resume as the application_id of a stored resume or as resume_text (the resume is then stored). Costs 1 HireLayer credit per search.

application_id.description: A stored resume. Give application_id or resume_text.

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 10 by default.

resume_text.description: A resume not stored yet, as plain text.

workspace.description: The client company this call belongs to, when the user recruits for several companies: its HireLayer workspace id (letters, digits and . _ : ~ -, up to 200 characters), e.g. acme-corp. Jobs, resumes and scores stay apart from other clients'. A new id creates a new workspace, so reuse the exact id. Omit it for the user's default workspace.

name: search_jobs
title: Job Recommendations
